description: Search Clef guides about converting, reading and learning music (MIDI, PDF scores, guitar tab, chord charts, piano apps). Use it when the user asks how to do a music workflow rather than for a computed answer. Returns up to 8 guides with title, description and resource uri (read the uri for the full guide) plus a link to the guide directory. Guides explain workflows; they do not convert files.

query.description: Plain words describing the task, for example "midi to sheet music" or "learn pop songs on piano". Matched against guide titles and descriptions.

name: find_music_guides

directory.description: Page listing every Clef music conversion guide.

guides.description: Best matches first; empty when nothing matched.

uri.description: Guide URL; also readable with resources/read.

title: Find Music Guides
